plugins.name: controllerai
plugins.description: Build, run, debug, and maintain visual automations with Controller AI. User-facing agent building is also supported.

skills.name: controllerai-agents
skills.description: Design, assemble, test, publish and share user-facing Controller AI agents built from instructions, knowledge files, workflow tools and ready integration actions. Use when creating or editing an agent, choosing its tool architecture, attaching tools, verifying draft or live conversations, or publishing and sharing it.

skills.name: controllerai-ai-nodes
skills.description: Configure and verify AI steps inside Controller AI workflows: the native Ask AI node, its provider, model, prompt and typed response, and the workflow actions that talk to a platform agent. Use when a flow needs generation, classification, extraction, summarization or structured AI output, or must create or message an agent conversation.
headings: Call a platform agent from a flow

skills.name: controllerai-data
skills.description: Define Controller AI custom data types and read, write, import, promote and debug workflow records in the development and live stores. Use when a workflow needs durable state, a custom.* type, a collection, record reads or writes, a CSV import, workflowData expressions, or data moved between development and live.

skills.name: controllerai-expressions
skills.description: Author, validate, persist, and debug Controller AI expressions for node props and conditions. Use when a value comes from a flow input, an upstream node, a loop item, workflow data, a constant, a calculation, a template or a boolean rule, and when an expression compiles but resolves to null or the wrong input.
headings: Discover the scope and the operations

skills.name: controllerai-flow-control
skills.description: Design and configure Controller AI execution paths with only-when guards, If/Else branches, Router routes, for-each loops, subflows, Join Paths and error handling. Use when work must skip, branch, fan out, iterate over a list, call another flow, converge, return a value, or continue after a failure without changing the user's intended semantics.

skills.name: controllerai-integration-actions
skills.description: Discover, connect, attach, update and verify ready integration actions that a Controller AI agent calls directly. Use when an agent needs one existing app operation without a workflow, when choosing between a direct action and a workflow tool, or when changing an action's connection or per-run approval policy.

skills.name: controllerai-node-config
skills.description: Discover, add, connect, configure, wire, and verify Controller AI workflow nodes. Use when adding an action, choosing a component, binding an account, setting props (static, optional, option-backed or dynamic), wiring nodes, resolving an output type, or fixing a node that is not ready.

skills.name: controllerai-runs
skills.description: Run Controller AI nodes and flows and read execution evidence: inputs, resolved configs, outputs, ports, skips, warnings and output-type adoption. Use when proving a build works, investigating a failed or green-but-wrong run, resolving a dynamic output type, or checking what an expression produced at runtime.
headings: Declare an output the user will not run yet

skills.name: controllerai-start
skills.description: Understand what Controller AI can build and choose the right deliverable — an agent, a workflow, a ready integration action, or a combination. Use at the start of any Controller AI task, when a user describes an outcome without naming a surface, and before loading a domain skill.
headings: Choose the deliverable from the interaction

skills.name: controllerai-triggers
skills.description: Discover, configure, create, capture, map, test, enable and debug Controller AI triggers: schedules, webhooks, email and app events. Use when an automation must start without a chat message, when a captured payload must become typed flow input, when replaying an event, or when asking why an automation did or did not start.
headings: Arm ambient development dispatch (only on request)

skills.name: controllerai-workflows
skills.description: Build, inspect, edit, recover, and publish Controller AI workflows and their flows. Use when a user asks to create or change an automation, a flow, or a workflow release, and for the lifecycle rules every other workflow skill relies on.
